65impl CacheUpdate for ChannelCreateEvent {
66    type Output = GuildChannel;
67
68    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
69        cache
70            .guilds
71            .get_mut(&self.channel.base.guild_id)
72            .and_then(|mut g| g.channels.insert(self.channel.clone()))
73    }
74}

76impl CacheUpdate for ChannelDeleteEvent {
77    type Output = VecDeque<Message>;
78
79    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<VecDeque<Message>> {
80        let (channel_id, guild_id) = (self.channel.id, self.channel.base.guild_id);
81
82        cache.guilds.get_mut(&guild_id).map(|mut g| g.channels.remove(&channel_id));
83
84        // Remove the cached messages for the channel.
85        cache.messages.remove(&channel_id.widen()).map(|(_, messages)| messages)
86    }
87}

100impl CacheUpdate for ChannelInfoEvent {
101    type Output = Vec<ChannelInfoChannel>;
102
103    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
104        let mut old: Vec<ChannelInfoChannel> = Vec::new();
105        let mut guild = cache.guilds.get_mut(&self.guild_id)?;
106
107        for channel_info_channel in &self.channels {
108            let mut channel = guild.channels.get_mut(&channel_info_channel.id)?;
109            let old_status = std::mem::take(&mut channel.status);
110            let old_voice_start_time = channel.voice_start_time;
111            channel.status.clone_from(&channel_info_channel.status);
112            channel.voice_start_time.clone_from(&channel_info_channel.voice_start_time);
113            old.push(ChannelInfoChannel {
114                id: channel_info_channel.id,
115                status: old_status,
116                voice_start_time: old_voice_start_time,
117            });
118        }
119
120        if old.is_empty() { None } else { Some(old) }
121    }
122}

124impl CacheUpdate for ChannelPinsUpdateEvent {
125    type Output = std::convert::Infallible;
126
127    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
128        if let Some(guild_id) = self.guild_id
129            && let Some(mut guild) = cache.guilds.get_mut(&guild_id)
130        {
131            let (channel_id, thread_id) = self.channel_id.split();
132            if let Some(mut channel) = guild.channels.get_mut(&channel_id) {
133                channel.base.last_pin_timestamp = self.last_pin_timestamp;
134                return None;
135            }
136
137            if let Some(mut thread) = guild.threads.get_mut(&thread_id) {
138                thread.base.last_pin_timestamp = self.last_pin_timestamp;
139            }
140        }
141
142        None
143    }
144}

146impl CacheUpdate for GuildCreateEvent {
147    type Output = Vec<GuildId>;
148
149    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
150        cache.unavailable_guilds.remove(&self.guild.id);
151        let guild = self.guild.clone();
152
153        cache.guilds.insert(self.guild.id, guild);
154
155        if cache.unavailable_guilds.len() == 0 {
156            cache.unavailable_guilds.shrink_to_fit();
157            Some(cache.guilds.iter().map(|i| *i.key()).collect())
158        } else {
159            None
160        }
161    }
162}

164impl CacheUpdate for GuildDeleteEvent {
165    type Output = Guild;
166
167    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
168        if self.guild.unavailable {
169            cache.unavailable_guilds.insert(self.guild.id, ());
170            cache.guilds.remove(&self.guild.id);
171
172            return None;
173        }
174
175        match cache.guilds.remove(&self.guild.id) {
176            Some(guild) => {
177                for channel in &guild.1.channels {
178                    // Remove the channel's cached messages.
179                    cache.messages.remove(&channel.id.widen());
180                }
181
182                Some(guild.1)
183            },
184            None => None,
185        }
186    }
187}

229impl CacheUpdate for GuildMemberUpdateEvent {
230    type Output = Member;
231
232    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
233        if let Some(mut guild) = cache.guilds.get_mut(&self.guild_id) {
234            let item = if let Some(mut member) = guild.members.get_mut(&self.user.id) {
235                let item = Some(member.clone());
236
237                member.joined_at.clone_from(&self.joined_at);
238                member.nick.clone_from(&self.nick);
239                member.roles.clone_from(&self.roles);
240                member.user.clone_from(&self.user);
241                member.premium_since.clone_from(&self.premium_since);
242                member.avatar.clone_from(&self.avatar);
243                member.banner.clone_from(&self.banner);
244                member.communication_disabled_until.clone_from(&self.communication_disabled_until);
245                member.unusual_dm_activity_until.clone_from(&self.unusual_dm_activity_until);
246                member.collectibles.clone_from(&self.collectibles);
247                member.set_pending(self.pending());
248                member.set_deaf(self.deaf());
249                member.set_mute(self.mute());
250
251                item
252            } else {
253                None
254            };
255
256            if item.is_none() {
257                let mut new_member = Member {
258                    __generated_flags: MemberGeneratedFlags::empty(),
259                    guild_id: self.guild_id,
260                    joined_at: self.joined_at,
261                    nick: self.nick.clone(),
262                    roles: self.roles.clone(),
263                    user: self.user.clone(),
264                    premium_since: self.premium_since,
265                    permissions: None,
266                    avatar: self.avatar,
267                    banner: self.banner,
268                    communication_disabled_until: self.communication_disabled_until,
269                    flags: self.flags.unwrap_or_default(),
270                    unusual_dm_activity_until: self.unusual_dm_activity_until,
271                    avatar_decoration_data: self.avatar_decoration_data,
272                    collectibles: self.collectibles.clone(),
273                };
274
275                new_member.set_pending(self.pending());
276                new_member.set_deaf(self.deaf());
277                new_member.set_mute(self.mute());
278
279                guild.members.insert(new_member);
280            }
281
282            item
283        } else {
284            None
285        }
286    }
287}

392impl CacheUpdate for MessageCreateEvent {
393    /// The oldest message, if the channel's message cache was already full.
394    type Output = Message;
395
396    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
397        // Update the relevant channel object with the new latest message if this message is newer
398        let guild = self.message.guild_id.and_then(|g_id| cache.guilds.get_mut(&g_id));
399
400        if let Some(mut guild) = guild {
401            let shared_id = self.message.channel_id;
402            let (channel_id, thread_id) = shared_id.split();
403            if let Some(mut channel) = guild.channels.get_mut(&channel_id) {
404                update_channel_last_message_id(&self.message, &mut channel.base, shared_id, cache);
405            }
406
407            if let Some(mut thread) = guild.threads.get_mut(&thread_id) {
408                update_channel_last_message_id(&self.message, &mut thread.base, shared_id, cache);
409            }
410        }
411
412        // Add the new message to the cache and remove the oldest cached message.
413        let max = cache.settings().max_messages;
414
415        if max == 0 {
416            return None;
417        }
418
419        let mut messages = cache.messages.entry(self.message.channel_id).or_default();
420
421        let mut removed_msg = None;
422        if messages.len() == max {
423            removed_msg = messages.pop_front();
424        }
425
426        if !messages.iter().any(|m| m.id == self.message.id) {
427            messages.push_back(self.message.clone());
428        }
429
430        removed_msg
431    }
432}
433
434fn update_channel_last_message_id(
435    message: &Message,
436    channel: &mut BaseGuildChannel,
437    channel_id: GenericChannelId,
438    cache: &Cache,
439) {
440    if let Some(last_message_id) = channel.last_message_id {
441        let most_recent_timestamp = cache.message(channel_id, last_message_id).map(|m| m.timestamp);
442        if let Some(most_recent_timestamp) = most_recent_timestamp {
443            if message.timestamp > most_recent_timestamp {
444                channel.last_message_id = Some(message.id);
445            }
446        } else {
447            channel.last_message_id = Some(message.id);
448        }
449    } else {
450        channel.last_message_id = Some(message.id);
451    }
452}

454impl CacheUpdate for MessageUpdateEvent {
455    type Output = Message;
456
457    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
458        for message in cache.messages.get_mut(&self.message.channel_id)?.iter_mut() {
459            if message.id == self.message.id {
460                let old_message = message.clone();
461                message.clone_from(&self.message);
462                return Some(old_message);
463            }
464        }
465
466        None
467    }
468}

470impl CacheUpdate for PresenceUpdateEvent {
471    type Output = Presence;
472
473    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Presence> {
474        if let Some(guild_id) = self.presence.guild_id
475            && let Some(mut guild) = cache.guilds.get_mut(&guild_id)
476        {
477            let old = guild.presences.get(&self.presence.user.id).cloned();
478
479            // If the member went offline, remove them from the presence list.
480            if self.presence.status == OnlineStatus::Offline {
481                guild.presences.remove(&self.presence.user.id);
482            } else {
483                guild.presences.insert(self.presence.clone());
484            }
485
486            // Create a partial member instance out of the presence update data.
487            if let Some(user) = self.presence.user.to_user()
488                && !guild.members.contains_key(&self.presence.user.id)
489            {
490                guild.members.insert(Member {
491                    guild_id,
492                    joined_at: None,
493                    nick: None,
494                    user,
495                    roles: FixedArray::default(),
496                    premium_since: None,
497                    permissions: None,
498                    avatar: None,
499                    banner: None,
500                    communication_disabled_until: None,
501                    flags: GuildMemberFlags::default(),
502                    unusual_dm_activity_until: None,
503                    avatar_decoration_data: None,
504                    collectibles: Collectibles {
505                        nameplate: None,
506                    },
507                    __generated_flags: MemberGeneratedFlags::empty(),
508                });
509            }
510
511            return old;
512        }
513
514        None
515    }
516}

518impl CacheUpdate for ReadyEvent {
519    type Output = NonZeroU16;
520
521    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
522        for unavailable in &self.ready.guilds {
523            cache.guilds.remove(&unavailable.id);
524            cache.unavailable_guilds.insert(unavailable.id, ());
525        }
526
527        let shard_info = self.ready.shard.unwrap_or_default();
528
529        cache.user.write().clone_from(&self.ready.user);
530
531        let mut shards = cache.shard_data.write();
532        shards.total = shard_info.total;
533        shards.connected.insert(shard_info.id);
534
535        if shards.connected.len() == shards.total.get() as usize && !shards.has_sent_shards_ready {
536            shards.has_sent_shards_ready = true;
537            Some(shards.total)
538        } else {
539            None
540        }
541    }
542}

577impl CacheUpdate for ThreadListSyncEvent {
578    type Output = std::convert::Infallible;
579
580    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
581        let mut guild = cache.guilds.get_mut(&self.guild_id)?;
582        let Some(channel_ids) = &self.channel_ids else {
583            // channel_ids is none, this is a full sync, easy path
584            guild.threads.clone_from(&self.threads);
585            return None;
586        };
587
588        // Add new threads and update existing threads.
589        for new_thread in &self.threads {
590            match guild.threads.entry(&new_thread.id) {
591                Entry::Occupied(mut entry) => {
592                    entry.get_mut().clone_from(new_thread);
593                },
594                Entry::Vacant(entry) => {
595                    entry.insert(new_thread.clone());
596                },
597            }
598        }
599
600        // Remove threads which are not provided in the sync and are in the provided channels.
601        let mut removed_threads = Vec::new();
602        for &channel_id in channel_ids {
603            for thread in &guild.threads {
604                if thread.parent_id != channel_id {
605                    continue;
606                }
607
608                if !self.threads.contains_key(&thread.id) {
609                    removed_threads.push(thread.id);
610                }
611            }
612        }
613
614        for to_remove in removed_threads {
615            guild.threads.remove(&to_remove);
616        }
617
618        None
619    }
620}

631impl CacheUpdate for VoiceStateUpdateEvent {
632    type Output = VoiceState;
633
634    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<VoiceState> {
635        if let Some(guild_id) = self.voice_state.guild_id {
636            if let Some(mut guild) = cache.guilds.get_mut(&guild_id) {
637                if let Some(member) = &self.voice_state.member {
638                    guild.members.insert(member.clone());
639                }
640
641                if self.voice_state.channel_id.is_some() {
642                    // Update or add to the voice state list
643                    let old_state = guild.voice_states.remove(&self.voice_state.user_id);
644                    guild.voice_states.insert(self.voice_state.clone());
645                    old_state
646                } else {
647                    // Remove the user from the voice state list
648                    guild.voice_states.remove(&self.voice_state.user_id)
649                }
650            } else {
651                None
652            }
653        } else {
654            None
655        }
656    }
657}

672impl CacheUpdate for VoiceChannelStatusUpdateEvent {
673    type Output = FixedString<u16>;
674
675    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
676        let mut guild = cache.guilds.get_mut(&self.guild_id)?;
677        let mut channel = guild.channels.get_mut(&self.id)?;
678
679        let old = if channel.status.as_ref().is_some_and(FixedString::is_empty) {
680            None
681        } else {
682            channel.status.clone()
683        };
684        channel.status.clone_from(&self.status);
685        old
686    }
687}

689fn update_guild_event(cache: &Cache, event: &ScheduledEvent) -> Option<ScheduledEvent> {
690    let mut guild = cache.guilds.get_mut(&event.guild_id)?;
691    guild.scheduled_events.insert(event.clone())
692}

720impl CacheUpdate for ReactionAddEvent {
721    type Output = Message;
722
723    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
724        let reaction = &self.reaction;
725        let mut messages = cache.messages.get_mut(&reaction.channel_id)?;
726
727        for message in messages.iter_mut() {
728            if message.id != reaction.message_id {
729                continue;
730            }
731
732            let prev = message.clone();
733
734            if let Some(existing) =
735                message.reactions.iter_mut().find(|r| r.reaction_type == reaction.emoji)
736            {
737                existing.count += 1;
738                if reaction.burst {
739                    existing.count_details.burst += 1;
740                } else {
741                    existing.count_details.normal += 1;
742                }
743                return Some(prev);
744            }
745
746            let me = self.reaction.user_id == Some(cache.current_user().id);
747            let new_reaction = MessageReaction {
748                me,
749                burst_colours: reaction.burst_colours.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
750                count: 1,
751                count_details: CountDetails {
752                    burst: u64::from(reaction.burst),
753                    normal: u64::from(!reaction.burst),
754                },
755                me_burst: if me { reaction.burst } else { false },
756                reaction_type: reaction.emoji.clone(),
757            };
758
759            message.reactions.push(new_reaction);
760
761            return Some(prev);
762        }
763
764        None
765    }
766}
767
768impl CacheUpdate for ReactionRemoveEvent {
769    type Output = Message;
770
771    fn update(&self, cache: &Cache) -> Option<Self::Output> {
772        let reaction = &self.reaction;
773        let mut messages = cache.messages.get_mut(&reaction.channel_id)?;
774
775        for message in messages.iter_mut() {
776            if message.id != reaction.message_id {
777                continue;
778            }
779
780            let old_message = message.clone();
781
782            let index = message.reactions.iter().position(|r| r.reaction_type == reaction.emoji)?;
783
784            let existing_reaction = &mut message.reactions[index];
785
786            existing_reaction.count -= 1;
787            if reaction.burst {
788                existing_reaction.count_details.burst -= 1;
789            } else {
790                existing_reaction.count_details.normal -= 1;
791            }
792
793            if existing_reaction.count == 0 {
794                message.reactions.remove(index);
795            }
796
797            return Some(old_message);
798        }
799
800        None
801    }
802}
